title: Calisthenics Skill Builder
summary: 30-minute skill session: wall-free handstand, pull-up, dip and L-sit ladders. Starts at Level 1; each cue shows the next rungs. Move up after hitting every set in two sessions.

steps.name: Wrist rocks
steps.cue: On hands and knees: rock forward and back palms flat, then fingers pointing toward knees, then on the backs of your hands.

steps.name: Band pull-aparts
steps.cue: Skip if no band. Squeeze shoulder blades together.

steps.name: Scapular pull-ups
steps.cue: Hang with straight arms; pull shoulder blades down and back, then relax. Elbows never bend.

steps.name: Scapular push-ups
steps.cue: In a plank, let the chest sink between the shoulder blades, then push the floor away.

steps.name: Deep squat pry
steps.cue: Sit deep, elbows inside knees, gently shift side to side.

steps.name: Cat-cow
steps.cue: Slow, full range through the spine.

steps.name: Hard plank, hands turned out
steps.cue: Squeeze everything. Wakes the shoulders up for handstands.

steps.name: Hollow body hold
steps.cue: Low back pressed down, arms by ears, ribs in, legs long. This is the handstand line, lying down. Bend the knees to make it easier.

steps.name: Cartwheel bail
steps.cue: From a lunge, hands down, kick up a little and turn out to one side, stepping down. Your exit with no wall: learn it before kick-ups.

steps.name: Pike hold (Handstand Level 1)
steps.cue: Hips high, shoulders over hands, push the floor away. Ladder: 1 pike 30s → 2 feet-up pike 30s → 3 crow 10s → 4 crow 30s → 5 tuck hops ×8 → 6 kick-ups ×8 → 7 free 5s → 8 free 15s → 9 free 30s+

steps.name: Active dead hang (Pull Level 1)
steps.cue: Shoulders pulled down, ribs in. Ladder: 1 hang 30s → 2 negatives 3×5 (5s down) → 3 band-assisted 3×8 → 4 strict 3×3–5 → 5 strict 3×8 → 6 strict 3×10+

steps.name: Dip support hold (Dip Level 1)
steps.cue: Arms locked, shoulders down away from ears, body straight. Ladder: 1 support 30s → 2 negatives 3×5 (3–5s) → 3 band-assisted 3×5 → 4 strict 3×3–5 → 5 3×8 → 6 3×12+

steps.name: Tuck L-sit (Level 1)
steps.cue: On dip bars or parallettes, knees tucked to chest, shoulders down. Feet may touch lightly. Ladder: 1 tuck 10s → 2 tuck 20s → 3 one leg out 10s/side → 4 full L 10s → 5 full L 20s+
